opening.argument: BitClub Network is promoted through daily profits and “100% passive income,” with payment as the route to participation: a lifetime membership fee followed by purchasing mining-pool shares. Viewers are also encouraged to recruit through a distribution network. The claim that it produced hundreds of cryptocurrency millionaires strengthens the wealth pitch without substantiation or risk disclosure. Together, these claims establish a scam pitch built around paying for mining returns.

citations.quote: purchasing a share in any one of their mining pools and earning daily profits.
BitClub Network provides 100% passive income with an option to build a distribution network
Become an exclusive member with a one-time membership fee paid once in a lifetime. That's the first step.
The second step is to purchase a share in one of the company's mining pools.
It has produced hundreds of cryptocurrency millionaires around the world.
